caseStudy.blurb: Agility's booth at MODEX 2026, the first physical activation of the new Agility brand.
caseStudy.team: Brand Designer (me), Director of Design, CMO, Event Coordinator, Booth Manufacturer
objectives: Bring the new Agility brand into physical space for the first time.
Keep materials, construction, and finishes consistent with the brand system.
Draw customer interest from across a crowded show floor.
caseStudy.contribution: As Brand Designer, I carried the new Agility identity off the screen and into a physical space for the first time. I held consistency across every material, construction detail, and finish, so the booth read as one brand system from the hanging signage down to the wall panels.
results: High foot traffic despite edge-of-floor placement.
Large-format prints with accurate color and resolution, on par with surrounding booths.
Team apparel the crew still wears around the office.
